text: nice go ahead and sweep through another set
resolution: Swept another adjacent set of prop recipes out of worldGeometry into one-file-per-prop modules: fence, treeOak variants, treePine variants, treeBirch, treeCypress, and treeDead. Each extraction preserves the existing dimensions/colors/part order while adding semantic part ids inside the recipe file. worldGeometry now imports those *Parts functions and delegates the matching switch cases. Verified with the focused compile/worldGeometry bundle and v8 test: 13/13 passed.
